construct_optimizer_sgd: construct an SGD optimizer with momentum for a PyTorch model using config hyperparameters
construct_optimizer_adam: construct an Adam optimizer with separate batchnorm weight decay for a PyTorch model
construct_optimizer_adamw: construct an AdamW optimizer with separate batchnorm weight decay for a PyTorch model
get_epoch_lr: get the learning rate for a given training epoch based on the lr policy config
set_lr: set the learning rate for all parameter groups in a PyTorch optimizer
